# Notice

Stickman Canvas is an independent implementation by kubcode.dev under the MIT licence (`LICENSE`).
The engine, example scene and characters (Nok, Pim) were written from scratch for kubcode. No code, characters or
assets from any third-party stick-figure kit are included. The cinematic stick-figure look is a general visual
style; credit for popularising it goes to the creators of stick-figure explainer channels.

Bundled third-party files:
- Anuphan font (Cadson Demak) — SIL Open Font License 1.1, `fonts/Anuphan-OFL.txt`.

Installed separately (not bundled): Playwright/Chromium (Apache-2.0), FFmpeg (LGPL/GPL).
